hatano_nelson_transition.gamma_method: Gapwise scan followed by bounded scalar optimization
hatano_nelson_transition.method: Direct float64 SVD of z I_n - A_n(a) at every grid point
hatano_nelson_transition.scope_note: The float64 computations are not interval-certified. The contours and gamma values are numerical illustrations and are not used as proof of the manuscript theorem.
